examples.arabic: أنا وأختي روحنا بيت تيتا إمبارح.
examples.english: My sister and I went to grandma's house yesterday.
examples.transliteration: Ana w okhti ro7na beit teeta embare7.

examples.arabic: أحمد قال: "ايوه، أنا شوفتها امبارح برضه".
examples.english: Ahmed said: "Yes, I saw her yesterday too."
examples.transliteration: Ahmed aal: "Aywa, ana shoftaha embare7 bardo."
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: إمبارح شغلّت مزيكا حلوة عشان أروّق دماغي، وكانت أغاني قديمة كتير عجبتني.
examples.english: Yesterday I played beautiful music to clear my head, and they were many old songs that I liked.
examples.transliteration: Embareh shaghghalt mazeeka ḥelwa ʾashan ʾarawwaʾ demaghi, we kanet ʾaghani ʾadeema keteir ʾagabetny.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

examples.arabic: أحمد راح السوق الكبير في القاهرة امبارح.
examples.english: Ahmed went to the big market in Cairo yesterday.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed rah el sooq el kebir fel Qahera embareh.

examples.arabic: امبارح قعدنا مع بعض واتكلمنا عن أحلامنا الجديدة.
examples.english: Yesterday we sat together and talked about our new dreams.
examples.transliteration: Embareh aadna maa baad we etkallamna aan ahlamna el gedida.

examples.arabic: هو كان مع اخواتي في البيت امبارح
examples.english: He was with my siblings in the house yesterday.
examples.transliteration: hwa kan ma akhwati fi el beit embareh
